name: Rope Trick
summary: A rope rises to an Invisible extradimensional space that holds up to eight Medium or smaller creatures.
text: Touch a rope. One end floats upward until the rope hangs straight up from the ground or reaches a ceiling. At its upper end an Invisible 3-by-5-foot portal opens into an extradimensional space that lasts until the spell ends; creatures reach it by climbing the rope, which can be pulled up into the space or dropped out of it. The space holds up to eight Medium or smaller creatures. Attacks, spells and other effects can't pass into or out of it, but those inside can see out through the portal. When the spell ends, anything inside drops out.
